description: Functions, limits, and intro to calculus concepts

cards.back:
(f∘g)(x) = f(g(x))

Apply g first, then f to the result.

f⁻¹ is the inverse of f if f(f⁻¹(x)) = x

To find f⁻¹: swap x and y, then solve for y.
Graph: reflection over y = x

Even: f(−x) = f(x)  [symmetric about y-axis]
Odd:  f(−x) = −f(x) [symmetric about origin]

Neither: most functions

cards.front: Vertical and horizontal asymptotes of a rational function
cards.back:
Vertical: set denominator = 0 (where undefined)
Horizontal:
• deg num < deg den → y = 0
• deg num = deg den → y = leading coefficients ratio
• deg num > deg den → no horizontal asymptote

aₙ = a₁ + (n−1)d

a₁ = first term, d = common difference

aₙ = a₁ · rⁿ⁻¹

a₁ = first term, r = common ratio

cards.front: Sum of a finite geometric series

cards.back: lim[x→a] f(x) = L means f(x) approaches L as x approaches a, regardless of f(a).

(a+b)ⁿ = Σ C(n,k) · aⁿ⁻ᵏ · bᵏ  for k = 0 to n

C(n,k) = n! / (k!(n−k)!)  ← binomial coefficient
